scope.lesson: All clinical data prose, case-caption/structured-analysis text and actual consumer source notes read comparatively DE/EN/FA. No image interpretation acceptance.

goals.assessment: Mix of clinical profile/measurement retrieval, pattern differentiation, report interpretation and tap-test selection. Case text self-contained. Supporting signs are explicitly limited; no forced numeric item quota.

findings.issue: FA flow-void wording could imply absent flow instead of flow-related signal loss.
findings.evidence: Actual question09 stem/option, card09 and lesson occurrences now use افت سیگنال ناشی از جریان (flow void). Existing question04 option already clear at baseline.

findings.issue: Cingulate posterior/anterior comparison needs explicit guideline attribution and paramedian plane precision.
findings.evidence: Japanese2021 CQ3 explicitly supports posterior narrower than anterior. Actual card/row paramedian; card source single valid CQ3 URL; visible page source note retains Adachi plus CQ3.

findings.issue: Generic appearance row DE/FA did not clearly describe signal loss and added unsupported CISS sequence generalisation.
findings.evidence: All three actual appearance cells now flow-related signal loss on sagittal T2. CISS removed from this generic row.

primaryEvidence.read: Original Japanese2021 guideline CQ3/CQ6/CQ7, standard CA plane, DESH/atrophy, cingulate comparison, negative tap false-negatives, drainage uncertainty and shunt selection/complications read.
Adachi2006 original abstract: small 10-iNPH sample among comparator groups; posterior tight cingulate sulcus on paramedian sagittal MRI. No stand-alone accuracy claim transferred.
Krauss1997 original prospective abstract: qualitative conventional-T2 flow void not a reliable individual shunt-selection predictor; not quantitative PC-MRI or CISS.
Official supplementary clinical chronology source: gait often earliest/most evident; not attributed to a new study.

limits: No independent browser interaction or rendered language/theme QA in this packet; author SSR is not treated as independent browser evidence.
Retained Radiopaedia73685 frames, CISS/T2 label and midsagittal case label not visually re-adjudicated; no claim of correct scan plane/frame selection or licensing review.
No complete source-PDF remapping or global scientific certification; physician release approval remains separate.
